command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "NODE_IP=$NODE_IP"
echo "== step: start test listener on 8080 =="
nohup python3 -m http.server 8080 --bind 0.0.0.0 >/tmp/http8080.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > /tmp/http8080.pid
echo "== step: start test listener on unrelated port 9999 =="
nohup python3 -m http.server 9999 --bind 0.0.0.0 >/tmp/http9999.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > /tmp/http9999.pid
sleep 1
echo "== step: verify SSH reachable on external IP =="
timeout 3 bash -c "cat < /dev/tcp/$NODE_IP/22" 2>&1 | head -c 100 || true
echo
echo "== step: verify 8080 reachable on external IP (should succeed) =="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP_CODE=%{http_code}\n" --max-time 3 "http://$NODE_IP:8080/" || echo "CURL_FAILED"
echo "== step: verify unrelated port 9999 is rejected on external IP (should fail/refused) =="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP_CODE=%{http_code}\n" --max-time 3 "http://$NODE_IP:9999/" || echo "CURL_FAILED_AS_EXPECTED"
echo "== step: cleanup test listeners =="
kill "$(cat /tmp/http8080.pid)" 2>/dev/null || true
kill "$(cat /tmp/http9999.pid)" 2>/dev/null || true
